notes: Receives privacy-minimized verified deployment task and private integration outcome events from the website's durable Make outbox. Create the webhook, connect Gmail, and set an internal operations recipient after import. Make should deduplicate by event_id because the website retries transient delivery failures.

metadata.notes: Create webhook: Helped Deployment Task Events. Payloads include event_id, event_type, agency_id, and event-specific opaque IDs/status. Do not expect document contents, signed URLs, applicant messages, or transcript text.
